items.what: In rust-v0.167.2 (Nov 11, 2026), Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI.
items.test: If you run Codex on Vertex AI, run a tool-heavy task after upgrading and check tool calls still complete. The release notes give the opt-out: set incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false under [features] in config.toml.

items.what: In langgraph-cli 0.4.43 (Nov 12, 2026), the discontinued local debugger image is removed: langgraph up --debugger-port now returns "No such option". New --studio-url and --api-url flags point to hosted Studio.
items.test: Search your scripts, Makefiles and CI for --debugger-port and remove it before upgrading; use the printed Studio link, or --studio-url and --api-url, instead.

items.what: In crewAI 1.15.40 (Nov 11, 2026), openai, azure and openrouter embedders use a native OpenAI function: no CHROMA_OPENAI_API_KEY fallback, and empty input raises ValueError instead of returning [].
items.test: If your embedder key lives only in CHROMA_OPENAI_API_KEY, move it to api_key, EMBEDDINGS_OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY, then run Knowledge or RAG with an empty document to see how your code handles the new ValueError.
